system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: For each evaluated method, we use one prompt template shared across all model families, and we do not tune prompts per model.
system_prompt_style.note: Budget hints (tell_search_limit/tell_context_limit) and a dynamically generated tool list may make it dynamically_composed; prompt-building code is not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The search_database tool is only available if the agent is still within itsmax_searches budget.
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval is a tool the model calls (BM25/hybrid backend). A retrieve_then_read baseline method, which injects retrieved snippets up front, is config-selectable. The default is b_star_04.

context_compaction.note: Loop source files are not in the evidence (truncated). A search_limit of 5 chunks bounds retrieval output, but no history rewriting is shown.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the result (an “observation") is returned to the model.

tool_call_format.note: The pythonic parsers pythonic_inline_01 (default) and pythonic_02 suggest Python-call syntax in the text. This is the closest value; the exact syntax is not seen in the evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: This loop continues until the model calls the ready_to_answer tool or a budget is exhausted.
tool_count.note: search_database + ready_to_answer, inferred from the paper; the tool registry is not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Chooses an action from a dynamically generated list of available tools.
edit_primitive.note: QA harness; only search and answer tools are described.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Prompts describe tools in plain language rather than bespoke APIs

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependency file was available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The BCAS algorithm is implemented as a stateful loop that guides the LLM through a budget-aware reasoning and retrieval process.
loop_primitives.note: The default b_star_04 loop is react. The retrieve_then_read baseline (fixed_pipeline) is selectable by method_name.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: When enabled, the agent decomposes the question into a step-by-step research plan
planning_granularity.note: use_preplanning is optional; whether the plan is stored as an object is unknown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Main BCAS loop: budget-aware search with optional preplanning and intermittent reasoning

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Main BCAS loop: budget-aware search with optional preplanning and intermittent reasoning

human_in_loop.note: The loop code is not in the evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The BCAS algorithm is implemented as a stateful loop
short_term_state.note: Budget counters are tracked. The state class is not visible.

state_persistence.note: Checkpointing is at the evaluation-batch level (CHECKPOINT_SYSTEM.md is not included). Whether it resumes is unverified.

self_verification.evidence_quote: This periodically prompts the model to review progress and make strategic adjustments
self_verification.note: The reflection option is off by default in the baseline. The LLM grader is used for evaluation, not in the loop.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This loop continues until the model calls the ready_to_answer tool or a budget is exhausted.
termination_condition.note: The loop stops at max_total_tokens (Sec. 3.3). The search cap removes the search tool. max_steps comes from react's max_steps.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the loop stops once the configuredmax_total_tokens

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the search tool is removed from the available action list
execution_isolation.note: The only actions are HTTP retrieval calls from the harness process, so there is no code execution to isolate.

permission_model.note: Search-budget gating exists, but it is not an authorisation model.

tracing.evidence_quote: Save flattened JSON outputs with token, cost, and evidence metadata.
tracing.note: The records are per-question results; whether per-step records are kept is unclear.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: A concurrent evaluation harness for budgeted agentic QA.

target_domain.evidence_quote: measuring the accuracy, evidence quality, and cost behavior of agentic retrieval pipelines
target_domain.note: Agentic RAG QA. Closest value is research; other is possible.

open_source.evidence_quote: This repository is distributed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

model_agnostic.note: Supports OpenAI, OpenRouter and DeepInfra model names.
